# The PaperTrail SEBI rulebook

<!-- Generated by `python -m papertrail.rulebook.catalog_doc`. Do not edit by hand. -->

PaperTrail compares what finance creators say with official SEBI rules and investor guidance. This page lists every check it runs and the official source behind each one.

## Two kinds of flag

| Label | What it means |
|---|---|
| **Official SEBI rule or guidance** | Comes from a fixed rule that cites a SEBI document we verified and link to. It describes what was said and what SEBI's material says. It is **not** a finding that anyone broke a rule. |
| **Potential concern (AI observation)** | Something the AI noticed that may deserve a closer look. It never names a regulation and is never presented as a violation. |

Only SEBI or a court can decide whether a rule was broken.

## Checks

### Promises of guaranteed or risk-free returns

- **What we look for:** A promise of guaranteed, assured or risk-free returns.
- **Why it matters:** SEBI's investor guidance says all securities investments carry some risk, and SEBI's caution on social-media frauds lists promises of assured or risk-free returns as a common trick.
- **What you should know:** No one can guarantee returns from the stock market. Treat any such promise as a warning sign, whoever makes it.
- **Official sources:** [Caution to public against Fraudulent / Manipulative activities on Social Media Platforms (SMPs) related to securities market](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/may-2025/1746621138080.pdf), [How to Spot a Scam](https://investor.sebi.gov.in/spot-any-scam.html)

### Claims of returns, accuracy or past performance

- **What we look for:** A claim about returns or performance (for example '300% returns' or '90% accuracy').
- **Why it matters:** Under SEBI's 2024 rules, making claims of returns or performance about securities without SEBI's permission is one of two 'prohibited activities' that SEBI-registered firms may not be associated with. SEBI also warns about misleading testimonials. A single impressive number is easy to cherry-pick.
- **What you should know:** Ask for a complete, verifiable track record, not one good number. PaperTrail checks the number itself in the claims section.
- **Relevant provision:** Regulation 16A, SEBI (Intermediaries) Regulations, 2008
- **Official sources:** [Details/clarifications on provisions related to association of persons regulated by the Board, MIIs, and their agents with persons engaged in prohibited activities](https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/jan-2025/details-clarifications-on-provisions-related-to-association-of-persons-regulated-by-the-board-miis-and-their-agents-with-persons-engaged-in-prohibited-activities_91356.html), [Caution to public against Fraudulent / Manipulative activities on Social Media Platforms (SMPs) related to securities market](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/may-2025/1746621138080.pdf)

### Specific stock recommendations without a confirmed SEBI registration

- **What we look for:** A specific buy/sell recommendation or price target for a security.
- **Why it matters:** SEBI requires anyone who publishes stock recommendations as a research analyst, including on the internet, to be registered (and anyone giving investment advice to be a registered investment adviser). We could not find this creator in our copy of SEBI's register. That is not proof they are unregistered: names can be written differently and our copy can be out of date.
- **What you should know:** Before acting on a stock tip, look the person up on SEBI's register (https://www.sebi.gov.in/intermediaries.html). Registered research analysts have a number starting with INH, investment advisers with INA.
- **Relevant provision:** Regulation 3(1), SEBI (Research Analysts) Regulations, 2014
- **Official sources:** [SEBI (Research Analysts) Regulations, 2014](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/aug-2026/1785912002778.pdf), [SEBI (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/aug-2026/1785912187595.pdf), [Details/clarifications on provisions related to association of persons regulated by the Board, MIIs, and their agents with persons engaged in prohibited activities](https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/jan-2025/details-clarifications-on-provisions-related-to-association-of-persons-regulated-by-the-board-miis-and-their-agents-with-persons-engaged-in-prohibited-activities_91356.html)

### Claims of SEBI registration we could not confirm

- **What we look for:** The speaker says they are SEBI-registered, but we could not confirm it.
- **Why it matters:** SEBI has warned that some people falsely claim SEBI registration or show fake SEBI certificates, and advises checking registration on SEBI's website. We could not find this creator in our copy of SEBI's register. That is not proof they are unregistered: names can be written differently and our copy can be out of date.
- **What you should know:** Search the name and registration number on SEBI's register (https://www.sebi.gov.in/intermediaries.html) and make sure they match the person you are dealing with.
- **Official sources:** [Caution to public against Fraudulent / Manipulative activities on Social Media Platforms (SMPs) related to securities market](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/may-2025/1746621138080.pdf), [SEBI cautions public to deal with only SEBI registered investment advisers and research analysts](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/docfiles/34058_t.html)

### Invitations to private Telegram, WhatsApp or 'VIP' groups

- **What we look for:** An invitation to a private Telegram/WhatsApp group or a 'VIP' or premium channel.
- **Why it matters:** SEBI has warned that scamsters lure investors into private WhatsApp and Telegram groups (named things like 'VIP group' or 'Investment Club') through social-media posts.
- **What you should know:** Be very careful with tips shared in private groups. If something goes wrong with an unregistered entity, SEBI's investor-protection mechanisms such as SCORES are not available. You can report such groups on SEBI's portal (https://mi.sebi.gov.in/).
- **Official sources:** [Caution to public against Fraudulent / Manipulative activities on Social Media Platforms (SMPs) related to securities market](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/may-2025/1746621138080.pdf)

### 'For education only' content that names stocks with targets

- **What we look for:** The content says it is for education (or 'not advice') but also names a specific stock with a target or a buy/sell view.
- **Why it matters:** SEBI's clarification says a person engaged solely in education should not use market price data of the preceding 30 days to name a security while indicating its future price, advice or a recommendation (the period was three months before 8 May 2026). This may matter if recent prices were used. A disclaimer does not by itself turn a recommendation into education.
- **What you should know:** Treat a named stock with a target as a recommendation, whatever the label says, and check whether the person is registered.
- **Relevant provision:** Annexure A, FAQ 8 of circular SEBI/HO/MIRSD/MIRSD-PoD-1/P/CIR/2025/11
- **Official sources:** [Details/clarifications on provisions related to association of persons regulated by the Board, MIIs, and their agents with persons engaged in prohibited activities](https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/jan-2025/details-clarifications-on-provisions-related-to-association-of-persons-regulated-by-the-board-miis-and-their-agents-with-persons-engaged-in-prohibited-activities_91356.html)

### Pressure to act immediately

- **What we look for:** Pressure to buy, join or pay quickly.
- **Why it matters:** SEBI's investor guidance lists pressure to decide immediately as a warning sign.
- **What you should know:** Real opportunities do not disappear in hours. Take your time and check first.
- **Official sources:** [How to Spot a Scam](https://investor.sebi.gov.in/spot-any-scam.html)

## Deliberately not checked

- **Missing disclaimers.** We have not verified an official requirement that applies to unregistered creators, so we do not flag its absence.
- **Whether price data was from the last 30 days.** We cannot see the data a creator used, so the 'education' check is worded conditionally.

## Always shown with results

- PaperTrail is not financial advice. It assesses specific claims against available evidence and does not recommend buying or selling any security.
- SEBI registration means a person or firm met SEBI's eligibility requirements. It does not mean SEBI endorses, approves or guarantees their advice or returns.
- Confidence describes how strongly the evidence we found backs our assessment. It is not a guarantee that a claim is true or false.
